title: Comelec proclaims district representative winners in Lanao del Sur
summary: The Commission on Elections on Tuesday proclaimed the parliamentary district representative winners in Lanao del Sur in the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM).

blocks.text: The Commission on Elections on Tuesday proclaimed the parliamentary district representative winners in Lanao del Sur in the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM).
Here are the winning candidates of the following districts in Lanao del Sur:

Six of the winning district representatives came from the Serbisyong Inklusibo-Alyansang Progresibo Party (SIAP Party), while the remaining winners came from the United Bangsamoro Justice Party (UBJP).
The BARMM held its first parliamentary elections on Monday, September 14, with 2.393 million registered voters.
As of 5:59 p.m. on Tuesday, the voter turnout in the BARMM elections reached 98.64%.

Commission on Elections chairman George Erwin Garcia earlier underscored the resolve of voters in the region to cast their ballots, noting that voter turnout had reached 80% at the time. –NB, GMA News
